fire-bolt.name: Fire Bolt
fire-bolt.description: Ranged spell attack, 120 feet, that burns one target and ignites loose flammable objects.

ray-of-frost.name: Ray of Frost
ray-of-frost.description: Ranged spell attack, 60 feet; a hit also cuts the target's speed by 10 feet until your next turn starts.

shocking-grasp.name: Shocking Grasp
shocking-grasp.description: Melee spell attack with advantage against metal armor; a hit stops the target's reactions until its next turn.

acid-splash.name: Acid Splash
acid-splash.description: One creature, or two within 5 feet of each other, within 60 feet must save or take the damage.

light.name: Light
light.description: A touched object sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for 20 more, for 1 hour.

mage-hand.name: Mage Hand
mage-hand.description: A spectral hand within 30 feet handles objects up to 10 pounds for 1 minute; it cannot attack.

sacred-flame.name: Sacred Flame
sacred-flame.description: One creature within 60 feet saves or takes the damage, with no benefit from cover.

guidance.name: Guidance
guidance.description: A touched willing creature adds 1d4 to one ability check of its choice within 1 minute.

spare-the-dying.name: Spare the Dying
spare-the-dying.description: A touched living creature at 0 hit points becomes stable.

magic-missile.name: Magic Missile
magic-missile.description: Three darts each deal the listed damage and hit chosen targets within 120 feet automatically.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Reaction when hit: +5 AC until your next turn starts, including against that attack, and magic missile deals you no damage.

mage-armor.name: Mage Armor
mage-armor.description: A touched willing creature wearing no armor has AC 13 + Dexterity modifier for 8 hours.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Roll 5d8; creatures within 20 feet of a point fall asleep, lowest current hit points first, until the total is spent.

burning-hands.name: Burning Hands
burning-hands.description: Creatures in a 15-foot cone save for half damage.

thunderwave.name: Thunderwave
thunderwave.description: Creatures in a 15-foot cube from you take the damage and are pushed 10 feet, or half damage and no push on a save.

detect-magic.name: Detect Magic
detect-magic.description: For up to 10 minutes you sense magic within 30 feet and can learn its school.

cure-wounds.name: Cure Wounds
cure-wounds.description: A touched creature regains the rolled hit points plus your spellcasting modifier; no effect on undead or constructs.

healing-word.name: Healing Word
healing-word.description: Bonus action: a creature within 60 feet regains the rolled hit points plus your spellcasting modifier.

bless.name: Bless
bless.description: Up to three creatures within 30 feet add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws for up to 1 minute.

guiding-bolt.name: Guiding Bolt
guiding-bolt.description: Ranged spell attack, 120 feet; the next attack roll against the target before your next turn ends has advantage.

shield-of-faith.name: Shield of Faith
shield-of-faith.description: Bonus action: one creature within 60 feet gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes.

inflict-wounds.name: Inflict Wounds
inflict-wounds.description: Melee spell attack against a creature you can reach.

command.name: Command
command.description: One creature within 60 feet that fails its save obeys a one-word order on its next turn.

misty-step.name: Misty Step
misty-step.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

scorching-ray.name: Scorching Ray
scorching-ray.description: Make three separate ranged spell attacks within 120 feet; each ray that hits deals 2d6 fire.

hold-person.name: Hold Person
hold-person.description: One humanoid within 60 feet is paralyzed for up to 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each of its turns.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.description: A touched creature is invisible for up to 1 hour, ending early if it attacks or casts a spell.

web.name: Web
web.description: A 20-foot cube of webbing restrains creatures that fail the save; escaping takes a Strength check against your spell DC.

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.description: Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere within 60 feet save for half damage.

spiritual-weapon.name: Spiritual Weapon
spiritual-weapon.description: Bonus action: a floating weapon lasts 1 minute, makes a melee spell attack, and can move 20 feet and attack again each turn.

lesser-restoration.name: Lesser Restoration
lesser-restoration.description: Touch ends one disease or one condition: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

prayer-of-healing.name: Prayer of Healing
prayer-of-healing.description: Ten-minute casting: up to six creatures within 30 feet each regain the rolled hit points plus your spellcasting modifier.

aid.name: Aid
aid.description: Up to three creatures within 30 feet gain 5 to current and maximum hit points for 8 hours.
aid.higher_levels: +5 hit points per slot level above 2nd

fireball.name: Fireball
fireball.description: Creatures in a 20-foot-radius sphere within 150 feet save for half damage.

lightning-bolt.name: Lightning Bolt
lightning-bolt.description: Creatures in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide save for half damage.

counterspell.name: Counterspell
counterspell.description: Reaction within 60 feet: stop a spell of 3rd level or lower; higher needs an ability check, DC 10 + spell level.
counterspell.higher_levels: Automatic against spells of the slot's level or lower

dispel-magic.name: Dispel Magic
dispel-magic.description: End spells of 3rd level or lower on one target within 120 feet; higher needs an ability check, DC 10 + spell level.
dispel-magic.higher_levels: Automatic against spells of the slot's level or lower

fly.name: Fly
fly.description: A touched willing creature gains a flying speed of 60 feet for up to 10 minutes.

haste.name: Haste
haste.description: One willing creature gets doubled speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, and one extra limited action for up to 1 minute.

revivify.name: Revivify
revivify.description: A touched creature dead for no more than 1 minute returns with 1 hit point; uses up 300 gp of diamonds.

spirit-guardians.name: Spirit Guardians
spirit-guardians.description: For up to 10 minutes, enemies within 15 feet of you have halved speed and save for half damage each turn.

mass-healing-word.name: Mass Healing Word
mass-healing-word.description: Bonus action: up to six creatures within 60 feet each regain the rolled hit points plus your spellcasting modifier.

beacon-of-hope.name: Beacon of Hope
beacon-of-hope.description: For up to 1 minute, chosen creatures within 30 feet have advantage on Wisdom and death saves and regain maximum hit points from healing.
